dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Have a question for me, cutie?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: All you need to do is add the ingredients into the cauldron, follow the steps provided, and you're good to go.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Using different herbs in the brewing process will, in turn, alter the effects of the potion. There's a whole bunch of combinations to try.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Bio-alchemical processing can infuse herbs with different effects and properties. The type of potion you want to brew will determine what kinds of herbs you need to cultivate.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: You'll need to consult the news of the market to determine what kinds of potions to brew.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I already took the liberty of compiling the latest details on the market for you. You can find the information I collected right by those shelves over there.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Well, if there's anything else you want to ask, don't hesitate to come and find me.

dialogues.speaker: Freda
dialogues.text: Hello there! As always, I, Freda, will do my best to assist you today.

response.speaker: Freda
response.text: Best of luck with your business!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Have a question for me, cutie?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: After observing your work, I made note of several improvements we can make to the brewing, cultivation, and sales aspects of the business.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Freda can tell you more about implementing these upgrades.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Well, if there's anything else you want to ask, don't hesitate to come and find me.

dialogues.speaker: Freda
dialogues.text: Hello there! As always, I, Freda, will do my best to assist you today.

response.speaker: Freda
response.text: Best of luck with your business!

dialogues.speaker: Atefeh
dialogues.text: So, are you ready to make more Mora with me?

response.speaker: Atefeh
response.text: According to my keen market sense, these are the kinds of potions that are currently in demand.

response.speaker: Atefeh
response.text: Hmm, okay. But don't wait too long. When it comes to making Mora, you've got to strike while the iron is hot!

dialogues.speaker: Atefeh
dialogues.text: Hello there. The potions from earlier have sold out.

dialogues.speaker: Atefeh
dialogues.text: I've organized the sales data for you. Feel free to have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Atefeh
dialogues.text: Let's skip right to talking about this deal, shall we?

response.speaker: Atefeh

dialogues.speaker: Deyou
dialogues.text: Greetings. I'm Deyou, a merchant from Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, are you here to purchase potions, too?

dialogues.speaker: Deyou
dialogues.text: That's right. Your store's doing pretty well, so I'm sure my sales will be good this time... Yeah, very sure...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You don't sound very confident...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey now, our potions are selling super well — orders just keep pouring in, we can barely cope!

dialogues.speaker: Deyou
dialogues.text: My apologies. I'm not doubting your sales figures...

dialogues.speaker: Deyou
dialogues.text: It's my business that hasn't been going too well. Every time I buy popular products, they just don't sell before prices go down all around — I post losses nine out of ten times.

dialogues.speaker: Deyou
dialogues.text: I always convince myself it's just bad luck, but if I have nothing but bad luck, does that mean that I'm just... not cut out for this...?

dialogues.speaker: Deyou
dialogues.text: If I don't make any money this time, I'll pack up, head home, and just work for my father.

choices.text: Maybe you're just choosing the wrong products?

response.speaker: Deyou
response.text: Is that so...? I suppose there's still much for me to learn.

response.speaker: Deyou
response.text: Right. You're right. I can't stay down like this. I'll make money this time — and I'll impress my father, make him see what I'm made of...

response.speaker: Deyou
response.text: Okay! Down to business. Let's talk terms.

response.speaker: Deyou
response.text: These are the types of potion I plan to purchase this time.

response.speaker: Deyou
response.text: Don't worry. Caution is the better part of valor — and business.

choices.text: Perhaps the issue is with your sales strategy.

dialogues.speaker: Deyou
dialogues.text: Down to business. Let's talk terms of cooperation.

response.speaker: Deyou
response.text: These are the types of potion I plan to purchase this time.

response.speaker: Deyou
response.text: Don't worry. Caution is the better part of valor — and business.

dialogues.speaker: Deyou
dialogues.text: The potions from last time have all sold out.

dialogues.speaker: Deyou
dialogues.text: This is the sales situation...

dialogues.speaker: Deyou
dialogues.text: I look forward to working with you in the future!

response.speaker: Deyou
response.text: These are the types of potion I plan to purchase this time.

response.speaker: Deyou
response.text: Don't worry. Caution is the better part of valor — and business.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Well, well, well. Your business sure is booming, cuties.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Sure enough, entrusting this job to you was the right choice.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Don't forget to take a rest if you need it, though. A cup of tea can do wonders when you're tired.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Public reception towards alchemical potions has been much more favorable than expected.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: If things continue like this, the potions industry could end up becoming a new revenue stream for the entire region of Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: We've got more than enough time to make big plans for the future. Right now, we should focus on the hard-earned success we've been able to achieve so far. How about we find a time to celebrate together?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, a celebration! As long as there's yummy food, Paimon's in!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Of course. Once I've made the preparations, you'll be the first to know. I'll even do you the honor of extending your invitation in person, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: That does sound nice. You certainly deserve to relax after all your hard work.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: #Greetings, {NICKNAME}, Paimon, and Lisa!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sucrose! It's been a while since the last time we saw you!

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: On the way here, I overheard quite a few people talking about alchemical potions.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: At first, I was worried something might have gone wrong with the herbs, but judging by the way people were talking, it seems like they were pretty pleased with the results!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Hehe, Sucrose, your bio-alchemical expertise was exactly what we needed for potion making.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! We've been able to make potions with all sorts of different effects!

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: #You mastered potion-making in such a short amount of time? I guess that's expected for someone of your talent, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: #I wouldn't be surprised if {M#he}{F#she} became a potion master one day.

choices.text: I've still got a long way to go...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: #Still, if you managed to master potion-making in such a short amount of time, {NICKNAME}, we should be able to start teaching the public about it as well.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Wait, was that also a part of Jean's plan?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Yep. It's something she and Mr. Albedo talked about... As I understand it, the goal was not just to create and sell potions, but also to teach the principles and practices of alchemy to the people.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Thanks to your shop, the public's understanding of alchemical potions has increased quite a bit. Perhaps, one day, they'll even be able to make simple potions themselves...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hmm, without the proper training, though, those potions could be dangerous to use...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: #You're right... With Lisa there to mentor you, {NICKNAME}, we could rest assured that nothing would go wrong during the potion-making process. However, when it comes to the general public, we have to think of a way to ensure that any resulting potions would be safe to use.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: So, Mr. Albedo is planning to establish a set of criteria to evaluate various levels of potion-making ability. People will have to pass the exam that corresponds to their level of proficiency before being allowed to brew their own potions.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Let me guess... You would like us to also take part in this exam?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Yes, although it would probably be more accurate to say that... we would like you to help us finalize the contents of the exam.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: #In order to ensure a proper level of difficulty, we need to first collect the relevant data. That's where our mock exam comes in. If you could take it, {NICKNAME}, your results would serve as a very important reference for us.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: You will, of course, be compensated for your efforts!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hehe, what a great idea! I must admit, I'm very interested to see how much my cutie's alchemy skills have improved.

choices.text: I guess I could give it a go.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Wonderful. Then let me explain a little bit about how the exam works. The exam has four levels: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, and Expert.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: To pass, all you need to do is brew a potion within the time limit that satisfies the main objective.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Satisfying additional objectives will earn you extra rewards.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, all this is starting to sound pretty official. Paimon's nervous all of a sudden.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Just do what you normally do and you should be fine. If you don't pass the first time around, you can always retake the exam, so no need to put too much pressure on yourselves.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, retakes are allowed! Phew, that's a relief!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Yep! Just let me know when you're ready.

choices.text: I still need a little more time...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: No problem, I'll be waiting for you here.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hehe, confidence is a good look on you, cutie!

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: #Oh, it's you again, {NICKNAME}! We can proceed with the exam whenever you're ready.

choices.text: Not yet, I need a little more time.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: No problem, I'll be waiting for you here.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Whenever you're ready, we can go ahead and proceed with the Beginner exam.

choices.text: Not yet, I need a little more time.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: No problem, I'll be waiting for you here.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Hm, your movements are quite practiced, and your potion meets the requirements as well. Congratulations on passing the Beginner exam!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, that was a piece of cake!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Even so, it was no match for your skills.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Alright, I believe I've collected all the necessary feedback... Looks like we'll have to make some adjustments to the level of difficulty for the actual exam.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: #I'm going to head back to the lab now. See you later, {NICKNAME} and Paimon!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Wow... I really thought it would be more difficult for someone so new to potion-making.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Eh, you are still pretty new to this. A few mistakes here and there are to be expected...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* Paimon just got a bit flustered when she remembered she was taking an exam...

choices.text: Guess we didn't prepare well enough...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Don't get discouraged. I also made all sorts of mistakes when I first started doing experiments. You know what they say — Practice makes perfect! I'll come back later and you can try again.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, how's the potion-making been going lately?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sucrose, you're back!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I should have known. You really do have a talent for alchemy.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I'm sure this exam will also be a walk in the park for you.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Well, ready to begin?

choices.text: I still need a little more time...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Alright! No rush! Take as much time as you need.

choices.text: We're still working out some kinks...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Well, you just need to keep practicing! You'll get the hang of it in no time.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: As for the Intermediate exam, just think of it as a practice session, and you'll be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: #Oh, it's you again, {NICKNAME}! We can proceed with the exam whenever you're ready.

choices.text: Not yet, I need a little more time.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: No problem, I'll be waiting for you here.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: If you're ready, then let's go and proceed with the Intermediate exam.

choices.text: Not yet, I need a little more time.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Alright! No rush! Take as much time as you need.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Let me see... Yep, looks like your potion meets the requirements. You've passed once again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, we're getting pretty good at this!

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: I'm so glad I asked for your help... Please, take this for your trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: It's alright. You'll get there. You just need a bit more practice.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: I'll come back later, and you can try again.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Hi, you two! It's been a while, hasn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, you're back! Wait... That must mean there's a new exam!

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Yep. It's time for the Advanced exam. This one will be harder than previous exams, but I'm sure you'll do just fine.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I'm sure you have nothing to worry about. I actually had Mr. Albedo take a look at your previous potions. He was a bit amazed that someone so new to potion-making could already produce such an impressive result.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: He even told me that, for someone of your talent, we could stand to set harder questions.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, the recognition feels nice and all... But, Paimon feels even more pressure now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If we don't pass this time, it'll be super embarrassing!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Don't worry too much about that. Lots of things in life require a couple of tries before you get it right.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: When I first started working as Mr. Albedo's assistant, all sorts of unexpected things would go wrong during my experiments...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: For example, when I was studying the properties of Mist Flowers, I accidentally froze all the equipment in the lab. I basically turned them into ice sculptures. Our precision instruments were nearly ruined beyond repair.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Another time, I let a reagent boil for a little bit too long, and all the precious ingredients inside got charred to pieces. The smell was so bad, several knights passing by thought the lab had caught on fire...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Back then, I would get really hard on myself whenever things went wrong, but eventually I realized that, in order to make new discoveries, you have to accept the risk of failure.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: A fear of making mistakes will prevent you from truly going after what it is that you want.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're absolutely right! Hey, you're actually really good at motivating people!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Hehe, it's just my experience talking — I've spent a lot of time doing research in the lab after all. Anyway, as long as you try, you'll learn something valuable from the experience.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Alright, whenever you're ready, we can go ahead and proceed with the Advanced exam.

choices.text: Not yet, I need a little more time.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: No problem, I'll be waiting for you here.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: #Oh, it's you again, {NICKNAME}! We can proceed with the exam whenever you're ready.

choices.text: Not yet, I need a little more time.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: No problem, I'll be waiting for you here.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Alright, whenever you're ready, we can go ahead and proceed with the Advanced exam.

choices.text: Not yet, I need a little more time.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: No problem, I'll be waiting for you here.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Wow, you even breezed through the Advanced exam...

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Ever thought about helping out around the lab?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Drop everything and pursue the path of an alchemy master... Huh, what do you say, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: Not sure we're quite ready for that yet.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: If we work together, I'm sure we could make something super amazing!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: By "super amazing," do you mean you already have something in mind?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Well, in the past, my research was mainly focused on the study of plants. But this experience has shown me that potions can have all kinds of effects on people as well...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: So, I started thinking — what if potions could have an even greater effect on people? Like... what if they could be used to help people unlock their hidden potential?

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: A memory-enhancing potion, for example, could help people memorize a whole library's worth of knowledge in a single breath.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Alternatively, a strength-enhancing potion could make it so that Paimon could take down an Abyss Mage all on her own.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Woah, Paimon didn't know you could make potions like that! Sounds awesome!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Well, it's certainly theoretically possible. Alchemy is, in itself, a way to explore the unknown. It's a discipline with endless potential. In fact, current research has barely scratched the surface of what's possible with alchemy.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Theory, though, is always easier than practice. And with alchemy, there are simply too many things that you have to take into consideration. Just off the top of my head, there's the theory of sublimation, the potion's mechanism of action, and the innate metabolism of the person consuming the potion...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, Paimon didn't quite catch all that...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Ah, my bad... We can talk about the details some other time. If you're interested, just stop by the lab.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sweet! Watch out, world — with a cool potion from Sucrose, Paimon will be able to become the strongest guide in Teyvat in no time!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Well, I'll be off, then. Only one more exam to go! I imagine you and I will both have some final preparations to make.

choices.text: But we can certainly help out.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Uh, this one was designed to be a bit difficult...

choices.text: I couldn't even follow the steps!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: You actually already have a lot of experience under your belt. I'm sure you just made a few silly mistakes. Maybe you exhausted yourself from working too hard recently.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: In any case, don't worry about it. We'll continue with the exam once you take a much needed break.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sucrose, you're here! Oh, is it time for the Expert exam already?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Our alchemy skills are improving so fast, Paimon can barely keep up!

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Your progress has been very impressive. In fact, according to the way Mr. Albedo designed the exams, passing the Expert level would mean you're now qualified to mentor other people.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, we could start to teach other people?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then Paimon's totally going to start a class! Hmm, let's see, how much should Paimon charge per student...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, all Paimon knows right now is that, for homework, her students are gonna have to use alchemy to make all sorts of tasty treats, hehe. Paimon'll be sure to give them lots of feedback... on their alchemy skills, of course!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I'm sure this one will go just as well as the others.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I'm ready to begin whenever you are. I'll be rooting for you!

choices.text: I still need a little more time...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Of course. This is the final exam. Take as much time to prepare as you need.

choices.text: Let's focus on the exam for now.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: #Oh, it's you again, {NICKNAME}! We can proceed with the exam whenever you're ready.

choices.text: Not yet, I need a little more time.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: No problem, I'll be waiting for you here.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Whenever you're ready, we can go ahead and proceed with the Expert exam.

choices.text: Not yet, I need a little more time.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Of course. This is the final exam. Take as much time to prepare as you need.

dialogues.speaker: Sucrose
dialogues.text: Alright, let me give your potion a try... Yep, the effect looks good. The quality of your potion is quite high as well. Your talent in this discipline is truly remarkable.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, we passed? Can we teach alchemy now?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: What an amazing achievement, cuties. Congratulations.

choices.text: I guess we've learned a thing or two about potion-making.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Now is not the time to be humble.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: You mastered potion-making in such a short amount of time. That's an impressive achievement no matter how you look at it.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Exactly! I was also really surprised at how quickly you picked it up. I thought it would have taken way more time...

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Anyway, thank you so much for your help. Your participation has allowed me to collect some very valuable data. With everything we've learned, we should be able to offer the official exams soon.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: This is sure to be a critical moment in the development of the alchemical potions industry.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon feels like she just took part in something super important!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Of course! You two are practically pioneers! What you've been able to contribute to the field of alchemy is as impressive as a biologist discovering a new species!

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: Anyway... I should probably head back and go over the data I've collected.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, thanks again for your participation. If you have some free time, please stop by the lab!

choices.text: But we're still by no means experts when it comes to everything else.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Noo, we didn't make it! This exam was way too hard.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: It's alright! This was the Expert exam, after all. It's really difficult to pass on your first try.

response.speaker: Sucrose
response.text: I'll come back once you've had some more time to prepare. Keep at it! I know you'll succeed in the end!

choices.text: We went over the steps in the wrong order...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Hey, what's up.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, it's been a while.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woah, Beidou and Eula! Wait... You two know each other?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Didn't expect to see you two together.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Haha, well we haven't known each other long, but we hit it off right away! I guess it was meant to be.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: I met Captain Beidou at Dornman Port. She was here in Mondstadt to buy some supplies, and I offered to accompany her around the area.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, Eula taking the initiative and making friends? ...Did Paimon hear that right?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Ahem, given that the two of us just met, I wouldn't go so far as to call us "friends" just yet. I was just... being hospitable. As is expected of a Knight.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Huh? I thought we were getting along pretty well... You're telling me you were just being polite?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Oh no, I didn't mean it like that. I just thought that... after my blunder earlier, you probably wouldn't want to be my friend...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Come on, it was just a little misunderstanding, that's all. You're still beating yourself up about that? Honestly, I'd forgotten all about it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Misunderstanding? What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Well, a few days ago, after docking at Dornman Port, I thought I'd treat the crew to some time at the tavern to blow off some steam.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: While we were there, an argument broke out between a couple of drunk guys. Things looked like they were about to get physical, so I intervened to try and break it up.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: I tried talking to them, but they were in the mood for a fight, and my words fell on deaf ears. So I had to resort to, uh... a more "hands-on" way of getting them to calm down.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Eula was patrolling the area while all this was going down, and when she walked in... It wasn't a pretty sight...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Ahem, I should probably take it from here.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Recently, we've intercepted a string of attempts to smuggle goods through Dornman Port, so we decided to step up our patrols in the area.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: On my rounds that day, I noticed a group of people I'd never seen before — and they were sailors. My suspicions were raised, so I asked their captain to show a valid entry permit for the port.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Captain Beidou said she didn't have the entry permit on her person and told me to check with the port authorities myself. I insisted that she should accompany me there, and well... you can see how things could get heated in a situation like that.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Hey, you were just doing your duty. It was my fault, really. I should've watched my tone, but I'd had a few too many, and... Anyway, it all worked out in the end. I took Eula back to my ship, showed her my documents, and that was that. Misunderstanding resolved.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: I felt bad, though, so I told her I'd treat her to a drink when we got back to the tavern.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Once we got to talking, we really hit it off. We sat there chatting until the tavern was about to close.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Captain Beidou mentioned that she wanted to have a look around the city the next day. I was also planning to head back to headquarters to submit some paperwork, so we decided to go together.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Ah, I meant to say earlier... Drop the "Captain" and just call me Beidou. There's no need for formalities between friends.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Oh, yes, of course. Pardon me for being so formal... Anyway, as for why we're here, I heard about your shop when I got back to headquarters, and after discussing it with Beidou, we decided to stop by and say hello.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: That's right! Plus, I'm curious to see what the deal is with these Mondstadt potions you've been brewing up.

choices.text: Since you came all this way...

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Could do... although I don't have any health issues, and my ship's already stocked with everything I could need out on the ocean.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Lemme think... Oh, do you have a potion that helps with getting to sleep?

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Are you having trouble sleeping, Beidou?

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: No, not me. The minute my head hits the pillow, it's lights out until the next morning!

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: It's just that, I have this friend... She doesn't lack for anything, and she eats right and drinks right, but she just doesn't sleep well. I don't know if it's a case of affluenza, or if she just has too many things on her mind.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, this "friend" you're talking about, you must mean...

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Yep. She's no stranger to rare and precious treasures, but I'd wager that, to her, the chance to relax and get a good night's sleep is rarer than any treasure in her collection.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, we'll get started on that order for you right away!

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Great! Thanks for the help!

choices.text: Why don't you buy some to bring back with you?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: We're back! Eula took me for a stroll around Starfell Lake. The scenery is amazing, especially from up in the hills.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: I'm glad you liked it. I was worried I might have bored you with all the aimless wandering...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Not at all! You're talking to someone who spends most of her days at sea. The opportunity to take a nice stroll through the woods is actually pretty special.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: #So, how's that potion coming, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: We still need a little more time!

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: No worries. I've got plenty of time before I have to head back.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: How's the potion-making going? Hope you didn't run into too much trouble...

choices.text: We just need a bit more time.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Take all the time you need! Just let me know when you're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What about you, Eula? Is there something we can make for you?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Hmm... I don't want to put too much on your plate. It wouldn't be fair to ask you to make so many potions at once.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Beidou came all this way... Her order should take priority.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Any potion requests I have on my end, I'll just submit to Lisa later — the same goes for anything the Reconnaissance Company needs as well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aww, you're so considerate of other people.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Oh, uh, you think so...? The Knights have always looked after me so well... Maybe it's rubbed off on me a little, or something.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: But I still have a lot to learn... The next time things get heated, I should approach the situation in a more level-headed way.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly! Compared to when we first met, you're practically picking up friends left and right!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's just like that Tone-deaf Bard once said — the winds always change their course!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Thanks, you two... Your kindness... really means a lot.

choices.text: Everyone can see how hard you're trying.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Perfect, looks like my gift is all set.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Is it time for your return journey, then? If you're heading back to Dornman Port, I'd be happy to accompany you.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Yeah, I think I've gotten my fill of sight-seeing, so it's probably time I headed back. Don't wanna keep my crew waiting.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, I'll see you some other time. Oh, and good luck with your business!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: On behalf of the Reconnaissance Company, I'd like to express my gratitude to you as well.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Huh, looks like potion-making is a pretty time-consuming endeavor.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Why don't I show you a few more places while we wait? We can come back in a little bit.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Alright! Catch you guys later!

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Hello, everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woah, is that Master Diluc!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Oh, Diluc. What's someone as busy as you doing in this neck of the woods?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Elzer told me the Knights launched a new commercial endeavor that turned out to be quite the hit. I think he was a bit surprised by the level of success, so he told me to come check it out.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: But, seeing as you two are the ones in charge, I'm really not surprised at all. The Knights definitely chose the most reliable people for the job.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, Elzer is the manager of Dawn Winery, right? Huh, Paimon thought he didn't get out much. Wonder how he heard about our shop...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, are we that famous already?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: No need to sound so surprised.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: The Winery keeps us all very busy. Elzer only takes the time to brief me with this sort of intel if he thinks we are faced with a real threat.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: In such a short amount of time, you've been able to establish complete production and supply lines, and even receive orders from all around Teyvat...

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: If you were in the wine business, you'd already be one of our biggest rivals.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Woah, woah! Threat? Rival?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Oh? You sure seem eager, cutie.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Looks like you really want to go toe to toe with the number one wine merchant in all of Mondstadt. Are you just itching to see whose business prowess would come out on top?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: #Hmm, a competition with {NICKNAME}... That's not a bad suggestion.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: You're extremely knowledgeable and well-traveled. If we were to become competitors, I'm sure you'd throw many a challenge my way — probably even some I've never faced before.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: But, I was really just using the wine industry as an example to emphasize your success. Our two industries aren't exactly fighting for the same market space.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Actually, the success of your potion shop is good for the Winery's business.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Good for your business? Paimon's lost. You were just talking about how the two industries were separate, and now they're suddenly connected?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hehe, it's a bit convoluted.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Alcohol is a commodity that most people consume in their free time. In order to have free time, though, you have to get off work early. For the alcohol industry to thrive, consumers need to have both the time and the money to spend.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: That's exactly right.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Your potions allow people to work more efficiently. As they get more popular, people will be able to complete their work faster. The more free time people have, the bigger the market there is for a commodity like mine.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, that makes sense! It's hard to be in the mood to go out and enjoy life if you're super busy all the time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon never thought about it that way before... There sure are a lot of layers to running a business!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Guess this means we're in the Mora-making business together, then. Hey, why don't you try out one of our potions?

choices.text: Please check out our offerings, dear partner!

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Hmm, I do have quite the interest in the effects of alchemical potions...

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Well, since you offered, please make a potion that can reduce the anxieties of the user while also improving their attention to detail.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Reduce anxiety while also improving the user's attention to detail? That almost sounds a little contradictory to me.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I must admit to being curious. If my cuties do manage to make this potion for you, Diluc, how exactly do you intend to use it?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Well, I mentioned before that people with ample free time are an important consumer base for my industry. But, actually, the same is true for people who are incredibly busy and overwhelmed with work.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: After a period of high stress, like a busy work day, it can take a while for people to fully decompress. It's also common for that type of stress to leave people so exhausted that all they can do is spend the rest of the day in a daze.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: That level of stress and exhaustion makes it hard for people to derive pleasure from things they usually enjoy... like relishing the flavor of their favorite food and drink.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* You can say that again...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's definitely been there before. Sometimes, after a really long day, Paimon'll be so tired, but she just can't relax. Not even her favorite snacks would hit the spot like they usually do...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: My poor little cuties. Sounds like things can get quite tough out on the road... You know what, you just earned yourself some extra snacks at our upcoming tea party. Once this is all over, I'll personally see to it that you get the chance for a proper rest.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, basically, you need us to make a potion that decreases tension, but increases attention, so that people can still enjoy the finer things in life no matter how busy or stressed they are... Did Paimon get that right?

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Exactly. Wine is meant to be savored. Drinking it without being able to appreciate its subtle notes and characteristics is a loss not just for the winemaker, but for the consumer as well.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: If we can increase the alertness of those too exhausted to perceive the subtle notes, but decrease the restlessness of those too agitated to raise their glass, then we can be sure to reach a point of balance where all can enjoy their wine to the fullest extent.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Well, um, it's definitely a unique request. Seems like this would be a tricky challenge for any potion-maker.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We should get to thinking, then. First things first, let's figure out what ingredients to use!

choices.text: If you want something, just name it, and we'll make it!
Fancy seeing you here, Master Diluc.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Have you made any progress with the potion I requested?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Right, the potion! You remember the details of the order, right {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've been working super hard on our potion-making skills recently, so we'll get right on it!

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: How's the potion coming? Have you finished?

choices.text: We just need a little longer...

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Not to worry. I know you're a trustworthy partner. With such individuals, I can be patient for as long as you need.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're finished with the potion, Master Diluc! Please give it a try!

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Oh? I thought you might need more time, but it looks like you've already found the solution. Nice job.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You hand over the potion to Diluc. After looking it over, he takes a small dose to test out the potion's effects...

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: Wow, the effect is even more apparent than I imagined. Your many talents just keep on surprising me.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: On behalf of Dawn Winery, I would like to make a bulk purchase order for this potion. Oh, and don't worry about the delivery side of things. Elzer will send someone to pick up the potions once they're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Diluc
dialogues.text: My plan is to enlist the help of artisans to infuse candles and fragrances with the effects of this potion. Those products will serve as complementary gifts for customers to enjoy during wine tasting.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: So you plan to make alchemical potions part of the wine-drinking experience itself... Interesting. And very much in keeping with the Dawn Winery's way of doing business.

choices.text: Looks like our new product's a hit!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If our potion was enough to impress Master Diluc, Paimon's sure regular customers are gonna be even more amazed!

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Well, there's still work to be done, so I should probably head out. It'll take some time before we know exactly what the commercial impact of this combination will be.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: In any case, it's been a pleasure working with you. Here's hoping our two businesses will have a long and successful partnership. I hope those orders will keep on rolling in... for both our sakes.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Oh, and if you have some time, you should stop by Angel's Share to see your masterpiece in action.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: For sure! Paimon can't wait! Well, see you next time, Master Diluc!

choices.text: We just secured a huge order from Dawn Winery!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, Paimon really doesn't know where to start...

choices.text: So many effects to keep track of.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Don't worry about it. I know I'm asking quite a lot from you two. You must be busy with your other orders as well. When you've got that much on your plate, it's easy to slip up here and there.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Just take it one step at a time, and you're sure to figure it out. I believe in you.

response.speaker: Diluc
response.text: Take as much time as you need, okay? I'm going to head back to the Winery for now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, sure was nice of Diluc to encourage us like that... Let's work extra hard so we won't let him down!

choices.text: It's so hard to find the right combination!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: #Hmm? {NICKNAME}? Paimon? Huh, looks like you're running a business...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, hey Diona! And Tone-Deaf Bard! What brings you to the shop?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I could smell what you were brewing from all the way across Cider Lake. Bards have an extremely keen sense of smell, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Again with the nonsense... Don't listen to him. We were actually in the middle of looking for some cocktail ingredients.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Margaret is getting ready to run a new promotion at The Cat's Tail, so she asked me to come up with some new drink ideas.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: The bard over here is performing at the event. When he saw me getting ready to leave, he insisted on tagging along to help.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Well, what better way to be the first to try your new concoction than by helping you collect ingredients?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that explains your enthusiasm, then. You're only that generous when alcohol is involved.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Anyway, I was having some trouble coming up with new ideas for ingredients to use. I've already experimented with just about every ingredient you can find around Mondstadt — even the weirdest ones.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: The bard saw me struggling and told me he had an idea, so we split up for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: I didn't get my hopes up, but sure enough, he came back a little while later with a rare ingredient I'd never used before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oooh! What is it? Some sort of secret? C'mon, bring it out so we can see!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hehe, it's a bird feather I found on a ruin in Dragonspine.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: It was once buried in snow, and is still cold to the touch even now.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: I'm sure it could be used to produce a drink with an entirely new sort of mouthfeel!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woah, well if anyone can find something like that, Paimon supposes it'd be you...

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, this ingredient is not easy to find. We'll probably use up the measly amount we've discovered with just the recipe testing alone.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Don't worry about the ingredients, Diona. I'll figure something else out. You should head back, so you can get a head start on working that mixology magic of yours.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Uh-huh, 'cause the sooner I get started, the sooner you get to take advantage of the fruits of my labor, isn't that right?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ah, well, just think of it as a way to pay me in advance for all my hard work, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: That still doesn't solve our problem, though...

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, do you have any ideas for a new drink?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Huh? Infuse drinks with different effects... But, doesn't that bring us back to the ingredient problem all over again?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh! Paimon gets what {M#he's}{F#she's} saying.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *ahem* You're looking at one of the most popular duos on the Mondstadt alchemy scene right now. Our potions are one of the hottest commodities in Teyvat!

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: But... what do potions have to do with drinks?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You can add them as an ingredient, of course! Potions can add all sorts of different effects... For example, with a little alchemy on your side, you could even make a drink that can heal a broken heart!

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Wow, I never knew potions could do something like that!

choices.text: Paimon's example is a bit of a stretch...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: I see. How about a potion that makes people never want to drink alcohol again? Could you make something like that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Woah, woah, woah. Don't go making promises we can't keep, {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How are we supposed to make a potion like that!?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Ah, what a shame... And here I thought I'd finally be able to dismantle the entire Mondstadt wine industry in one fell swoop.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's okay, we'll try to see if we can find some other ways to help.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Actually, I've always been curious, Diona — is there a particular reason you don't like alcohol?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Hah, isn't it obvious? Ever been around a drunk person before? Let me tell you, it's not a pleasant experience!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Ah, so your gripe isn't really with alcohol itself, but the fact that it makes people drunk!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Hmm, this may sound a little weird, but I wonder if it's possible to use this mysterious alchemy craft of yours to make a drink that prevents people from getting intoxicated?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hmm, so you mean, a potion that can keep someone sober and awake? Sounds like something we could do. Whaddaya say, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: If we just need to produce something that invigorates the mind...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Perfect! I can just see it now! The more alcohol those drunkards consume, the more sober they'll become...

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: They'll finally have to say bye bye to their days of drunken depravity!

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: #It's decided then! {NICKNAME}, please make me a potion that can keep people sober!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Gotta say, I'm starting to get really curious about what that drink's going to taste like.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, that's right. Even if we could make one that discourages people from drinking, it would only last for a little bit before wearing off.

choices.text: But, more reasonable effects are absolutely doable.
You could infuse drinks with different effects...

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Phew, we're back! That was quite the successful outing!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ingredient-collecting went a lot faster with my help, didn't it? C'mon, admit it!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Well, I suppose you weren't entirely useless.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: So, how's the potion coming? Finished yet?

response.speaker: Diona
response.text: Take your time. This is a crucial part of my plan to take down the Mondstadt wine industry. I'll wait as long as it takes!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hmm, if alchemy has the power to transform matter... I wonder if it could also be used to turn water into wine?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Wouldn't it be amazing if all the water in Cider Lake turned into actual cider?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: In that case, at least, no matter how short on Mora I am, I'd never be short on liquor, haha...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How about I treat you to a drink instead?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: A fine alternative, haha. Who would I be to refuse such a generous invitation?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: We'll go as soon as your work is finished. How does that sound?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You really haven't changed at all... Just the mention of alcohol practically has you chomping at the bit!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Well, it's not everyday I get the chance to reunite with such dear friends. What's a reunion without a generous serving of wine?

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Wow, I can't believe I'm holding the key to shaking up Mondstadt's entire wine industry in my own two hands... Wowzaa!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: #Thank you so much, {NICKNAME}! I'm gonna head back and start developing my new drinks right away!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Wait, don't leave without me! I thought you were gonna let me be the taste tester!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Of course, hehe... Operation "eliminate drunkards" has just begun, and you, my friend, are my first test subject...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: #And just like that, another problem solved! Looks like you've done it again, {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Alcohol that doesn't make you drunk... If I'm able to develop something like that... I guess there really is a type of alcohol that I can get behind...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, this potion is turning out to be trickier than Paimon thought it would be...

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Well, making a potion that has the power to topple the wine industry is sure to be complicated — more complicated than mixing drinks, at least.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: You know what? I'm gonna take a look around the area to collect some more materials.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ah, if you're looking for high-quality materials, I know just where to go!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: #Perfect! Lead the way... {NICKNAME}, Paimon, we'll see you later!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Bye! See you soon!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Oho, so you're the ones behind the potion shop I've heard so much about! When it comes to fulfilling requests, I heard the customer's wish is practically your command.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Gorou? Where did you come from?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, and Kirara's here too! What are you guys doing in Mondstadt?

choices.text: Didn't expect to see you here!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Hehe, the Komaniya Express operates all across Teyvat, so I'm always on the road.

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: I'm actually pretty familiar with Mondstadt from my trips here in the past. General Gorou, on the other hand... seems to still be getting the lay of the land... He got lost not too far from here...

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: *ahem* Well, I would normally be provided with ample intel before carrying out an operation in a foreign territory... But, Watatsumi Island isn't exactly home to many people who've been to Mondstadt. I wasn't even able to obtain a map of the region.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: I've basically had to perform initial reconnaissance in the middle of a formal operation — not exactly ideal conditions for an error-free mission!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Affirmative, General! Next time, I'll procure the most detailed map available and make sure you have it at your disposal from mission outset! Over and out!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: You can drop the formalities, Kirara. I don't expect you to report back to me like I'm your commanding officer. We hired you as a consultant. It wouldn't be fair to treat you like one of my soldiers.

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Hey now, it's not like this is some one-sided partnership. We agreed, right? In exchange for my services, you'll help promote our business to the people of Watatsumi Island. Your good word will be integral in helping the Komaniya Express become people's first choice for all their delivery needs!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Our future business is counting on you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Back to Paimon's question, though. You still haven't told us what you're doing in Mondstadt. You mentioned something about a mission?

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Ah yes... It's a funny story actually.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Recently, Watatsumi Island has been looking for ways to increase transportation efficiency. Basically, this means improving the operations of our cargo ships. So, we decided to send teams across Teyvat to learn about the most advanced techniques different nations have to offer.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: We had just wrapped up our trip to Liyue when we heard word of your mysterious potion shop. So, we decided to postpone our return journey for a bit and come check it out.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Turns out it was the right choice!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, Paimon's gotta say, you've practically hit the jackpot by coming here! We've got stuff you can't find anywhere else!

choices.text: We'll make you something super special!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Oh? More customers from abroad? Hehe, my cuties sure are popular. You really do have friends all over Teyvat...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Hm, looking at your two friends here... I can't help but be reminded of my dear little wolf cub... You know what? I should introduce you some time. For some reason, I have a feeling the three of you would really hit it off...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: In fact, once you've wrapped up your potion purchasing, why don't you both join me and my cuties for afternoon tea? I'll even bring my student along.

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Afternoon tea? Sounds great! I could really use some refreshments. Long days of deliveries always leave me parched. Thanks for the invitation!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Uh, something tells me you're not going to take no for an answer, hehe... Wait, why does this feel so familiar...

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: #Uh, anyway... {NICKNAME}, care to make some introductions?

choices.text: This is the guardian mage of tomes and spells!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: G—Guardian mage? Wow, what an impressive title... Is it a position similar to that of a Guuji?

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Or, wait... Could it be that I'm in the presence of someone as high-ranking as Her Excellency, like Lady Sangonomiya herself!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Honestly, {NICKNAME}... You're gonna give the guy a heart attack.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't be nervous, Gorou. That's just, uh... a nickname! Her real name is Lisa. She's works as a librarian here in Mondstadt. And, she's also the person in charge of our shop!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Lisa, this is Gorou. He's a suuuper powerful general from Watatsumi Island. And this is Kirara. She's a suuuper punctual delivery woman with the Komaniya Express.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Kirara... Hmm, the name sounds familiar. Ah, the collection of books from Inazuma that I have in the library... You were the one who delivered them, yes? What a helpful little gem, you are!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Hehe, I'm glad our paths have crossed again, Miss Lisa. I hope you'll consider me for future delivery jobs as well!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: As for my cuties' other acquaintance... I believe I've read a few articles about you, General Gorou. I seem to recall more than a few references to your empathetic nature and skillful approach to leading your troops.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Let me guess... Your troops are also the focus of your potion inquiry here today?

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Exactly!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Commercial activity between Watatsumi Island and other regions has been on the rise recently. The workload has increased so much, both the soldiers who work on our shipping convoys and the sailors who work on the merchant vessels are struggling to keep up.

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: What would really come in handy would be a potion that could help them handle their intense workload. Like one that could enhance their energy and physical strength.

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Okay, I could definitely use a potion like that as well!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: When I'm out on a long delivery, you wouldn't believe how tired my legs would get from trekking across all that rugged terrain — not to mention the damage it does to my paws.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: My cuties should be more than familiar with that kind of potion by now. I'm sure they'll have it done in no time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep, leave it to us!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Well, while you two hop to it, I'm going to find an idle knight to deliver a letter to my little wolf cub, and ask him to treat us to the pleasure of his company.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Once my cuties are done brewing a potion that satisfies your needs, we'll all celebrate over afternoon tea!

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Hehe, afternoon tea on the banks of Cider Lake... Wonder what that'll be like? I can't wait to find out!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Phew, I'm just glad I've finally found a way to help my troops...

choices.text: She also makes a mean cup of tea!
We'll make sure you leave with something fun and useful!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon! We're back!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: I just finished buying some souvenirs around the city. I believe you took a trip to The Cat's Tail, right Kirara? I saw you leaving, at least.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Yep. I stopped by to visit my sweet little Diona, but she was nowhere to be found. Such a shame... Well, at least I still got a refreshing drink out of it. Maybe I'll have better luck next time.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Still remember our request, you two?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Of course! You're after a potion that could increase a person's energy and enhances their physical strength — a very practical request if Paimon does say so herself.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Our potion-making skills are getting better by the second. We'll have it brewed and ready in no time!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: ...I thought I've told you before, that if you want to pass through the forest undetected, you're gonna want to wet your tails. Wet fur doesn't get snagged on branches and twigs as easily as dry fur. You'll be able to slip on by, and your enemies will be none the wiser...

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Nuh-uh, that's not gonna happen. I can't stand my tails wet. I'd be better off... tying them in a knot or something — or better yet, improving my fighting skills so that I don't have to sneak by them in the first place...

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Oh, you're here! How's the potion coming?

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: Well, I'm rooting for you! I've seen how capable you are. No way a few alchemical roadblocks can stand in your way!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Gorou, Kirara, your potion is now ready! Why don't you give it a try?

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Wonderful! You two sure work fast!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Wow! My right shoulder was acting up from using my bow so much... But a few drops of your potion, and the pain is completely gone...

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Th—The pain from walking on all that rough terrain... it's like it was never there! I thought you dealt in potions, not magic elixirs!

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: With this in my arsenal, I bet I could deliver two hundred orders in a single day!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, looks like we've got another hit on our hands! Guess we can add the people of Watatsumi Island and the workers at the Komaniya Express to our list of happy customers!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, now that our work is out of the way, there's nothing standing between us and that afternoon tea we were promised...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, perfect! Lisa's here.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I'm sorry to report my little wolf cub appears to be busy. I sent someone to fetch him in Wolvendom, but he wasn't there... It's such a shame he's going to miss the opportunity to meet some fellow furry-eared companions.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: But, I'm sure you'll have the chance to meet in the future. In fact, the next time I see him, I'll be sure to tell him about the two of you. It'll give him something to look forward to.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Lisa sets out a tableful of exquisite snacks and delectable tea. With good company by your side, the gathering turns out to be a very pleasant affair...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: While Kirara appears to enjoy her meal immensely, Gorou seems a bit nervous. His mannerisms bear a striking resemblance to how he acts around a certain Lady Guuji...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Wow, you've placed quite the sizeable order. Thank you for your patronage, my Inazuman friends.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: If feedback on the potion is favorable, I hope you'll consider reupping your supply when the time comes. If making the journey proves too troublesome, we can always ship them to you.

response.speaker: Kirara
response.text: Of course! I have a feeling this super powerful alchemical craft of yours could be a game changer for the entire delivery industry!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: #Absolutely. I'll be sure to collect detailed feedback from my troops... Anyway, we should head out. Until next time, {NICKNAME} and Paimon. Oh, and it was a pleasure meeting you, Miss Guardian Mage.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Bye Gorou! Bye Kirara!

response.speaker: Gorou
response.text: The next time I'm in Mondstadt, I should make it an official visit. A formal meeting between Her Excellency and the Honorable Guardian Mage is sure to be a momentous occasion!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, seems like that made-up title really had an impression on him. It's given him all sorts of funny ideas...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: #Wow, potion-making is really complicated. I guess it's quite a time-consuming process, even for two people as capable as {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: Yeah, watching them run around in circles like this is making me dizzy...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like we've still got some details to work out. Sorry to keep you waiting...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: No worries! Take as long as you need! In any case, I was hoping I'd get the chance to walk around a bit more and familiarize myself with the terrain. It'll give me a chance to buy some souvenirs and books as well.

dialogues.speaker: Kirara
dialogues.text: I guess I'll take some time for myself too... Hmm, where should I go... Ooh, I know! The Cat's Tail!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: #See you in a bit, {NICKNAME} and Paimon. Be sure to pace yourselves, alright? Don't go working too hard on our account!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Officially submit.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Why, hello there, you two! You're ready for the alchemy ranking exam now.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: The exam has four levels: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced, and Expert.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: To pass, all you need to do is brew a potion within the time limit that satisfies the main objective.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Satisfying additional objectives will earn you extra rewards.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Just let me know when you're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Check the exam requirements...

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: #Oh, it's you again, {NICKNAME}! We can proceed with the exam whenever you're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Check the exam requirements...

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: If you're ready, then let's go and proceed with the exam.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Check the exam requirements...

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Congratulations! You passed!

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Don't worry about it. I'll be back later.

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Let's start the Intermediate Exam, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Check the exam requirements...

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Ready to take on the Advanced Exam?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Check the exam requirements...

dialogues.speaker: Timaeus
dialogues.text: Let's get to the Expert Exam, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Check the exam requirements...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Officially submit.
